notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Sources: FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001099590-26-000006, filed February 25, 2026) and 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001099590-26-000010, filed April 23, 2026), read on EDGAR; the Galperin Trust holding still rests on the Schedule 13D/A filed November 1, 2024. LEADER: Marcos Galperin was CEO through 2025; on January 1, 2026 Ariel Szarfsztejn became CEO and Galperin became Executive Chairman (2026 proxy letter). The proxy shows him directly owning just 35 shares (marked *, less than 1%), received in a distribution from Kaszek Ventures. GALPERIN TRUST: the proxy lists 'Galperin Trust' separately at 3,550,136 shares (7.00%) and does not attribute it to Marcos Galperin. The 13D/A describes Galperin Trust /SD only as an irrevocable South Dakota trust 'established for the benefit of certain individuals and certain charitable organizations', with Corpag Trust South Dakota Inc. as trustee, and names no beneficiaries. It is therefore listed as a holder of type 'other', not as his stake or as a family holding, and not added to his figure. HOLDERS: Baillie Gifford's 13G/A filing date (April 30, 2025) is given, not its as-of date, so asOf is null. BUYBACKS: the cash-flow line shows $1 million of repurchases in 2025 (as in 2024), recorded as 0.001 billion rather than rounded to 0.00 so it is not shown as zero. STOCK COMP: null. Employee long-term pay is the cash-settled LTRP, under which certain employees receive cash payments over six years, half varying with the share price; in 2025 the company paid $238 million of LTRP ($82 million fixed, $156 million variable). The 10-K says there were no outstanding stock options at December 31, 2025. The equity statement shows $1 million of 'Stock-based compensation - restricted shares issued', but the 10-K states no share-based compensation expense, and the cash-flow line 'Long term retention program ("LTRP") accrued compensation 303' ($ millions, 2025) includes the fixed cash portion, so neither is recorded as share-based compensation. workers.plan is null because the LTRP is a cash bonus for certain employees rather than stock. GEOGRAPHY: segment revenues are from external customers and sum to the $28,893 million total.
